title: AlphaDog Styles Unisex Hoodie for Adults - Dog Breed Geometric Art, Front Emblem and Full Body Back Print
desc:
Wear your best friend. Bold geometric faceted illustration of your dog's breed on a soft heavy-blend hoodie: a small emblem portrait on the front and the full body drawing across the back.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Style: pick your breed.
2. Color: pick the color.
3. Size: pick your size.

FABRIC AND FIT: Gildan 18500 heavy blend hoodie, about 8 oz, 50% cotton / 50% polyester, double-lined hood, pouch pocket and matching drawcord. Classic roomy fit - size down if you like it snug.

DETAILS
- Printed in the USA, made to order just for you.
- Finished with the AlphaDog Styles logo label.
- Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit within the US. Tracking included.

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors. Tumble dry low. Do not iron or dry clean the print.
